metadata.name: S1 AI Report
metadata.description: Fetches thread list, filters for AI/LLM topics, fans out up to 8 threads to fetch replies, summarizes, and fans in to merge into a report.

edges.prompt:
Here is a list of forum threads: {data}
Filter and return ONLY the threads related to AI, LLM, GPT, artificial intelligence, etc. Output ONLY a valid JSON list of objects: [{'tid': '...', 'title': '...', 'url': '...'}].

Summarize the following forum thread discussion from the last 24 hours: {data}
Focus on AI/LLM trends, user opinions, and key points. Output markdown.
